scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/contracts build && concurrently -k -n api,web 'pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/api dev' 'pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/web dev'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/contracts build && pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/api build && pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/contracts build && pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/api test && pnpm --filter @cluster-sql/web test && python3 tests/backup_test.py
